We also have Amazon's best quality refurbished iPhone 17 Pro models with up to $220 off, fleeting Apple Watch Series 11 summer deals starting from $299, and the latest Nitro Black Beats 240W braided USB-C cable on Amazon at $18 (40% off), creating one of the best prices ever. Cheapest 24GB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air discounted by $200 today, more deals

AirPods Pro 3 deals have continued throughout the summer, and we even have M5 Pro MacBook Pro at $500 off, but discounts on the M5 MacBook Air have remained relatively rare over the past month or so. We started seeing Amazon offer $100 off the newer pricing to slightly ease the markup pressure, but we also just discovered a significant $200 drop on the 24GB model, which Amazon doesn't carry, at B&H.

Amazon is currently offering $100 off on multiple 13-inch and 15-inch M5 MacBook Air configurations:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,199 (current price, original price $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,499 (current price, original price $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,699 (current price, original price $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,399 (current price, original price $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,699 (current price, original price $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,899 (current price, original price $1,999)

As shown above, Amazon does not carry the official 24GB/1TB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air configuration — the cheapest 24GB model you can buy. However, Apple authorised reseller B&H has it, currently selling at $200 below the listed price:

B&H is selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB RAM and 512GB storage for $1,499 with free shipping. The original price is $1,699, now selling $200 below the listed price.

This is one of the best M5 MacBook Air deals we've tracked since the official price increase.

If you're looking for a MacBook Pro, this week we have multiple configurations at $400 and $500 below the listed price, not limited to top-tier models:

Get the M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB at $500 off, 48GB model at $400 off, more deals

In addition to AirPods Pro 3 continuing at $50 off during 'Black Friday in July', and all colours of Apple AirPods Max 2 at $100 off, we also continue to see significant price relief on the latest M5 MacBook Pro lineup after the price increase. Highlights include a 14-inch 24GB/2TB M5 Pro model from Amazon at $500 below the listed price, and a 48GB model on B&H at $400 below the listed price.

This can be said to be the best-value M5 Pro MacBook Pro deal we've tracked since the price increase took effect — Amazon is selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro for $2,499 with free shipping. Originally priced at $2,999, this model comes with 24GB RAM and 2TB internal storage, $500 below the newer listed price.

Considering Apple just raised the price of this configuration by $400, and this machine never dropped below $2,340 on Amazon even before the price increase, this deal is particularly good value.

Another highlight of this week's MacBook Pro deals is the 14-inch 48GB/1TB M5 Pro model from B&H, selling for $2,799 with free shipping. You do have to pay more here for double the RAM, but this is also $400 below the $3,199 listed price, and it's a configuration you simply can't get on Amazon.

Amazon's best quality refurbished iPhone 17 Pro models discounted by up to $220, 17 Pro Max up to $450 off

If you want to purchase a current-generation iPhone 17 Pro or Pro Max at a discount, there are some options this week. Deals on brand-new unlocked models from reputable sources are rare, but we still tracked Amazon's best quality refurbished 17 Pro status with up to $220 off, while Woot is once again featuring 17 Pro Max deals with up to $450 off.

On Amazon, 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models have reappeared, with up to $220 off — these are Amazon Renewed Premium models, with a 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and 'over 90% original battery life'. Standard Amazon refurbished units only offer a 90-day warranty and don't come with the same battery guarantee.

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (original new price $1,499)

  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,199 (original new price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,199 (original new price $1,299)

However, on Woot, the larger 17 Pro Max deals are still running on 'brand new unused' condition units. You can get up to $450 off Apple's listed price here, but colour options are starting to dwindle:

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB $1,300 (original price $1,399)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB $1,450 (original price $1,599)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB $1,550 (original price $1,999)

Apple Watch Series 11 summer deals starting to disappear, grab the most popular models while they're still $100 off

While we continue to track AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off for the summer, AirPods Max 2 at $100 off, and the historic low price deal on the 4-pack Apple AirTag 2, the cheapest Apple Watch Series 11 discounts are starting to disappear. If you're interested in upgrading your Apple wearable with a $100 discount, you'll want to act fast.

Amazon is currently selling the 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 for $299, and the 46mm model for $329 with free shipping. That's $100 below the original listed prices of $399 and $429 respectively, for the cheapest models you can buy.

However, colour options for these deals are starting to dwindle. There are still a few colours selling at the discounted price, but it looks like these summer discounts on the Series 11 are starting to sell out or revert to higher prices this week.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (original price $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (original price $429)

AirPods 4 Active Noise Cancellation version drops to as low as $119 on Amazon, other models from $99

Summer and 'Black Friday in July' deals on the current-generation AirPods lineup continue into this week. We still track AirPods Pro 3 at $50 below the listed price, and all colours of AirPods Max 2 at $100 off. However, we also still track the best price in months for the AirPods 4 Active Noise Cancellation version, as well as Amazon Renewed Premium models as low as $119.

Amazon is selling the Apple AirPods 4 Active Noise Cancellation version for $144.99 with free shipping. Originally $179, that's 20% below the listed price — the best deal we've seen since March.

Remember, you can also currently pick up an Amazon Renewed Premium version for $119 — this is an Amazon Renewed Premium model with a 1-year warranty, offering Amazon's best refurbished quality.

For some people, unless you particularly want the AirPods 4 form factor, paying $55 more for a pair of AirPods Pro 3 while they're discounted would be a better value choice than these deals, but whichever one you want, we continue to track significant discounts across all models.
